name: ListPositions
summary: ListPositions is a utility Expert Advisor that scans and lists all currently open positions in the terminal, displaying their details such as ticket number, symbol, type, lot size, open price, and profit. It does not open, modify, or close any trades on its own. The EA serves as a monitoring and information tool for traders who need a quick overview of their portfolio state.
summary_zh: ListPositions是一个工具型EA，用于扫描并列出终端中所有当前持仓的详细信息，包括单号、品种、方向、手数、开仓价格和盈亏等。该EA不会自行开仓、修改或平仓，仅作为持仓监控和信息展示工具使用。
strategy_analysis: 该EA本质上不是交易策略，而是一个持仓信息展示工具。它的核心功能是遍历所有当前持仓并将关键信息输出到终端或图表上。入场条件不适用，因为该EA不会开仓。出场条件不适用，同样因为不涉及平仓操作。仓位管理方面，EA仅读取已有持仓的手数信息，不做任何仓位调整。资金管理方面，EA可能展示总盈亏和持仓占用保证金等信息，但不会执行任何资金管理操作。整体上，该EA属于辅助型工具，帮助交易者快速了解当前账户持仓状况，提升交易决策的信息透明度。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is fundamentally not a trading strategy but a position information display utility. Its core function is to iterate through all currently open positions and output key details to the terminal or chart. Entry conditions are not applicable since the EA does not open trades. Exit conditions are not applicable as it does not close positions either. In terms of position management, the EA only reads the lot size of existing positions without making any adjustments. For money management, the EA may display total profit/loss and margin usage information but does not execute any money management operations. Overall, this EA is an auxiliary tool that helps traders quickly understand their current account position status, improving information transparency for trading decisions.

parameters.name: ShowOnChart
parameters.description: 是否在图表上显示持仓信息

pros: 提供清晰的持仓全景视图，便于交易者快速掌握账户状态
不执行任何交易操作，使用安全无风险
可自定义刷新频率和信息展示方式，灵活性较好
pros_en: Provides a clear panoramic view of positions for traders to quickly grasp account status
Does not execute any trading operations, safe and risk-free to use
Customizable refresh frequency and display format, offering good flexibility
cons: 功能单一，仅提供持仓列表，缺乏深度分析能力
无预警或通知功能，当持仓出现异常变化时无法及时提醒
不包含任何交易逻辑，对希望自动化交易的客户没有直接帮助
cons_en: Single-function, only provides position listing without deep analytical capability
No alert or notification feature, cannot promptly warn when positions show abnormal changes
Contains no trading logic, provides no direct help for clients seeking trade automation
improvements: 增加持仓异常预警功能，如浮亏超过阈值时自动提醒
增加持仓统计分析功能，如按品种/方向汇总盈亏和风险敞口
improvements_en: Add abnormal position alert functionality, such as automatic notification when floating loss exceeds a threshold
Add position statistical analysis features, such as summarizing profit/loss and risk exposure by symbol/direction

risk_points: 该EA不执行任何交易操作，无交易风险
需确保刷新频率设置合理，过高的刷新率可能影响终端性能
risk_points_en: The EA does not execute any trading operations, no trading risk
Ensure refresh frequency is set reasonably, excessively high refresh rate may impact terminal performance
